title: Weekly Chief Inspector Report
contractor: Not recorded — contractor daily reports by Jose Salaises (Job #1119)

sections.heading: Executive Summary
paragraphs: Mobilization week. The contractor mobilized on Friday 11/20 with 8 personnel, set up welding machines and fabrication areas, started piping fabrication and welding (118.24 weld inches), and began civil layout for drilled piers and foundations with the one-call made. A field coordination meeting on 11/20 set the official 07:00 CT start time and the daily reporting, documentation and H₂S requirements. The contractor's scatter sheet for 11/20–11/25 was received.

No field records were found for Saturday 11/21. Main risks: incomplete contractor reporting (no line/iso, welder count or RT data yet), an unconfirmed completion target ("the 18th", month not stated), material theft on site, and H₂S exposure near the tank battery. Decisions needed from MPLX: confirm the completion date and confirm the geotechnical report in Dropbox is the project report (RFI 16).

bullets: Material receiving and review against MTRs scheduled 11/20 per scatter sheet; MTR results not reported.

No hydrotest packages submitted (required 24 hours before each test). No NCRs recorded.
